name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3362: His ruling on the machine-identity banner: ONE banner, ONE sentence, ONE writer; it may claim its own world and must NOT claim separate economy. #37 sat blocked all day on a single value only the GrokBot seat could read, and when it arrived at about 17:25 IDT - window.D2R_BUILD.id = v3360, with the banner rendering as LINUX - its own world - Mac untouched - the value revealed there was NOTHING TO FIX. MEASURED in bible.html rather than assumed: its-own-world appears three times, at L3840 and L4274 as COMMENTS and at L48984 as CODE, so exactly ONE code writer; Mac-untouched appears once, on that same L48984; and all four separate-economy hits belong to the LADDER. The ruling was already kept, and this law exists so that it cannot quietly stop being kept. ⚠⚠ THE LADDER RIBBON IS NOT THIS BANNER, AND A FILE-WIDE BAN WOULD HAVE DELETED A CORRECT SENTENCE. The ladder ribbon reads LADDER ACCOUNT - separate economy - your main account is untouched, and that claim is TRUE there: items forged on a ladder character genuinely do not sync to main, which is the ladder doctrine. One phrase serving two different features is the trap, and the cheap wrong move would have been to ban the phrase across the file. This law pins the MACHINE banner by its own writer, one case PROVES the ladder ribbon is left alone and still says what it should, and a further case REFUSES to judge at all if the two elements ever come within 200 characters of each other, because at that point position can no longer tell them apart. ⚠ COMMENTS ARE NOT CLAIMS: two of the three its-own-world hits are prose explaining the feature, and grading prose as a claim is the defect that has cost this repo five versions, so the reader strips line comments before counting. ⚠ THE BASELINE IS PINNED TOO, or the law would pass over a banner that says nothing at all: an empty banner is not compliance, so the permitted claim must still be present. ⚠ WHAT UNBLOCKED THIS WAS NOT THE QUEUE. The seat answered at about 16:04 and again at 17:25 and neither post reached #230 because its GitHub mutate was blocked; the frames and a paste-ready reply had been sitting on his Mac the whole time. The channel that worked was the disk, not the issue. HEART: this version adds a LAW over an existing static claim and adds no surface, no lane and no store. A string composed by one writer has no live state for a watcher to read - what can rot is the code, and that is exactly what a gate catches. The gate exists, is registered, and all three of its red-proofs have been SEEN red. 481 gates, 5 cases, 3 red-proofs PROVEN.
